definition: a small thing that goes wrong by chance, like dropping something
description: A run of small mishaps, one after another. A black phone lies face down on a wooden kitchen floor where it has just landed. On a city pavement a girl holds an ice cream cone with only half a scoop left, the rest of it splattered pink on the ground beside her feet. In an office a woman in a blue blouse throws up her hands in panic as a whole file of white papers flies out of her arms and scatters through the air. In a kitchen a man's plastic bag splits and oranges, peaches and a jar roll out across the tiled floor. Finally a watermelon bursts open on a market street, pink flesh and juice sprayed in a wide splash, while shoppers jump back with their hands over their mouths.

taps.phrase: to hold a bag of fruit
